raw_text: Stanford Internet Observatory Report: AI-Generated News Anchor Network Targeting India. SIO has documented a network of at least 15 YouTube channels and 30+ social media pages using HeyGen-style AI-generated news anchors to disseminate fabricated anti-India content. The synthetic presenters deliver professional-quality news bulletins containing false narratives about internal unrest and economic collapse. Metadata analysis traces hosting infrastructure to servers in Islamabad, Pakistan and Shenzhen, China, suggesting a coordinated cross-national information operation.
